en-US.description: Free, offline-first focus workspace: pomodoro timers with automatic breaks, sticky notes, habits, tasks.
en-US.longDescription: Nerva by Bytical is a persistent focus workspace for deep work. Pomodoro timers with automatic breaks that survive sleep and reboot, floating sticky markdown notes, a year-long habit heatmap, tasks, world clocks and an optional AI assistant with your own key. Offline-first, no account, Apache-2.0.
en-US.name: Nerva
